statements: I labeled all 18 cases and all 24 turns of the v2-holdout cloud case set blind, before seeing any Skill output.

Inputs not read: runtime code, test suites, prior benchmark artifacts, oracle notes (oracle-notes.json), holdout plans (V2_HOLDOUT_PLAN.md), scoring code (score_semantic.py, validate_cases.py), designer attestation, and every other labeler's labels or outputs.

Every turn uses the exact v2 gold fields from the GOLD_RUBRIC: turn_index, route, responsibility, tone, overall, required_question_topics, allowed_question_topics, required_revision_facts, allowed_revision_facts, critical_invariants, rationale.
Question-topic and revision-fact lists use sorted canonical concept tokens from SEMANTIC_ONTOLOGY.json; every required topic/fact also appears in the corresponding allowed list.
Critical invariants use the canonical GOLD_RUBRIC tokens; no-image-token-guess is applied to the two image_ocr turns and no-unsafe-commitment to turns with unauthorisable or unsupported commitments.

All 24 turns route as Normal mode (manager recipient, identifiable message, usable background), so no null ratings are used; each overall status follows the fixed derivation Red > Gray > Yellow > Green.
